company_name: Sunto Semiconductor Technology Shanghai Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Sunto Semiconductor Technology specializes in equipment manufacturing for the semiconductor industry, particularly in gas delivery systems.
summary: Founded in 2008, Sunto Semiconductor Technology Shanghai Co., Ltd. focuses on the manufacturing of ultra-high purity (UHP) gas delivery equipment, including gas cabinets and racks. The company also develops ancillary equipment such as temperature controllers and automatic switching devices, providing tailored solutions for the semiconductor, LED, and solar industries.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
